description: This file defines the implementation of the EquationViewModel class, including methods for populating graph features, handling errors, and managing related data structures for graphing calculator equations.

classes.name: GridDisplayItems
classes.description: Represents display items for grid elements, including expression and direction.

classes.name: KeyGraphFeaturesItem
classes.description: Represents a key feature of a graph, including title, display items, and whether the content is text.

classes.name: EquationViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class for managing equation data, graph features, and error handling in a graphing calculator.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::PopulateKeyGraphFeatures
methods.description: Populates key graph features based on the provided graph equation info, handling errors and adding features.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a key graph feature with a single expression or error message.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a key graph feature with multiple expressions.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddParityKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds parity information as a key feature.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddPeriodicityKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds periodicity information as a key feature.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddMonotoncityKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds monotonicity information as a key feature.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddTooComplexKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds information about features that are too complex to analyze.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::EquationErrorText
methods.description: Returns localized error message text based on error type and code.
